name: Explain cryptographic concepts, algorithms, and attacks
description: Users asked for explanations of various cryptographic algorithms, protocols, and security concepts, including classical ciphers, symmetric and asymmetric encryption standards, and quantum cryptography. The requests also involved solving specific mathematical problems, analyzing algorithm vulnerabilities and attacks, and understanding practical implementations such as file encryption and key management.
